change: Daily expired units are capped at 5% of latent demand and at available stock after fulfilled sales; closing stock and wastage ledger are recalculated.
guardrail: Daily expired units are capped at ceil(5% of latent demand) when original expiry is positive, with a minimum 1-unit allowance, and capped at available stock after fulfilled sales. This is a configurable synthetic assumption, not an industry benchmark.
important_limitation: Purchase orders and goods receipts retain their V2 records. This V3 patch recalibrates expiry/wastage and end-of-period snapshot; it does not yet rebuild procurement order quantities or perform a complete FIFO batch-age simulation.
do_not_claim: Do not present V3 wastage reduction as a measured AI improvement. It is a dataset simulation correction.
